pack.name: Tunisia NDA Pack
pack.description: Tunisian law pack for non-disclosure agreements (demo sample — legal review required).

sectionDefinitions.name: confidentiality
sectionDefinitions.title: Confidential Information
sectionDefinitions.description: Definition and protection of confidential information.

clauses.title: Party identification
clauses.content: This NDA is between [Disclosing Party] and [Receiving Party]. Demo sample — legal review required.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.content: The Receiving Party agrees not to disclose or use Confidential Information except for [Purpose], and to perform its obligations in good faith under Article 243 of the Code des obligations et des contrats. Demo sample — legal review required.

clauses.title: NDA term
clauses.content: The obligations of confidentiality survive for five (5) years after the termination of this NDA. Demo sample — legal review required.

clauses.title: Governing law
clauses.content: This NDA is governed by Tunisian law, including the Code des obligations et des contrats (Decree of 15 December 1906, reorganized by Law No. 2005-87 of 15 August 2005). Demo sample — legal review required.

validationRules.name: tn_nda_required_sections_complete
validationRules.description: All required sections must be present.

riskPlaybook.name: tn_nda_risks
rules: Survival period shorter than the agreed protection term.

sources.title: Code des Obligations et des Contrats (Tunisie) — confidentialité
sources.description: Tunisian Code of Obligations and Contracts — confidentiality provisions (demo sample, legal review required)

chunks.content: Article 242 COC: Contractual obligations validly formed bind the parties as law and may only be revoked by their mutual consent or in cases provided by law. Demo sample — legal review required.

Article 243 COC: Every engagement must be performed in good faith; it binds not only to what is expressed but also to all the consequences that law, usage or equity give to the obligation according to its nature. Demo sample — legal review required.
